title: P6 restart/resume classifier defaults whole directories to canonical resume, so 'unclassified = 0' is structurally weak
impact: The P6 record says R1 removed the permissive A default and classification is positive. The classifier returns G_UNCLEAR for unknown paths, but about 40 prefix rules (incl. intergrax/runtime/execution/, runtime/events/, integrations/, skills/, queueing/, long_running/) map every present and future module to A_CANONICAL_RESUME. A new resume-bearing module under these prefixes is auto-classified canonical; the 159/0 inventory cannot detect a new bypass or duplicate owner there (only the 15-concern owner matrix would).
recommendation: Owner to confirm whether prefix-level A classification is the intended P6 contract; if not, require per-module positive classification or an owner-matrix extension, and rerun P6 gates at the baseline.
